decisions.reason: As a small accessory with very low carrying costs and close fit to the existing trailer business, it is worth keeping on the market while demand uncertainty resolves.

A box car trailer series sits squarely in the firm's core range and homepage promotion suggests strategic importance, so management would likely keep the option open despite some portfolio-complexity risk.
The car transporter trailer is a more specialized and potentially costlier niche product, but after only about a year there is still enough uncertainty to justify waiting rather than exiting.
The low-bed trailer series extends the professional-use offering in a familiar product area, and there is no strong signal yet that its value has been disproven.
A high trailer cover series is a modular complement to the core trailer business and likely inexpensive to continue offering while the market response becomes clearer.

Because this box car trailer series may overlap with another new box trailer line its rationalization risk is relatively higher, but real-options logic still favors keeping it for now given the short time since launch.
